( 087) 4083927 baptisms: 2nd & 4th saturdays of the month. confessions available on request before mass. let your light shine! a saint lets the light of the lord’s presence shine through their lives. just as there are many colours in a stained-glass window, so the light of christ can shine through people’s lives in a whole variety of ways. we each reflect the light of the lord in a way that is unique to each of us. the lord needs all of us, all our colours, if he is to shine in our world today. let the light of christ shine forth in you today. happy feast day! ~ fr gerard. for emergencies only please ‘phone: during the week fr gerard finucane (087) 0554874 fr jerry keane (087) 2844649 fr pat (087) 2200114 from 1pm sunday –9am monday this weekend only fr john buckley (087) 2409624 first friday communion calls fr jerry will make his first friday communion call on wednesday the 4th of nov. & fr gerard finucane will make his calls on the 5th & 6th nov. at the usual times.

diocesan collection for irish church commissions & agencies will be taken up next weekend 7th & 8th november. this collection supports the work of the national bishops conference and its commissions and agencies. it funds h=the church at a national level. it enables diocese to work together to have a common voice where appropriate. 200th anniversary of st marys church committee will hold a church gate collection this weekend. thanks for your support. mass for the deceased of the past year, on thursday the 19th of november 7pm, we will remember in a special way all our faithful departed who have gone to their eternal rest during the last year. relatives and friends are warmly invited to attend this memorial mass during which a candle will be lit for each of the departed and their names will be remembered in prayer. you are welcome to then take the candle home. if you would like to remember someone who died outside the parish since last november, please drop their names in the letterbox of the presbytery.

removed_lines: love god, love your neighbour. we don’t love in order to get to heaven; we love because heaven is already ours in christ. we don’t love in order to win god’s favour; we love because we already have god’s favour in christ. we don’t love so that god will love us; we love because god has loved us in christ with the greatest love we will ever know, the crucified love of jesus.
